summary.tldr: Exempts extra-energy-efficient products from GST and adds a 10% income tax credit for individuals who buy them, up to $1,000 a year.
what_it_does: Creates a GST exemption for supplies of extra-energy-efficient products, including listed appliances, air conditioners, heat pumps, furnaces, water heaters, lighting, electronics and electric motors.
Creates an income tax credit for individuals who buy extra-energy-efficient products, equal to 10% of the amount paid, up to $1,000 a year.

Lets the Governor in Council designate products or product classes as extra-energy-efficient by regulation if they beat the current energy-efficiency standard by at least 10% and have less than 50% of the domestic market.
Requires those regulations to be reviewed at least every five years.
Lets the Minister fix how the tax credit is split if more than one person can claim it for the same product.
summary.background: The bill adds a new "extra-energy-efficient" category to the Excise Tax Act and the Income Tax Act. That category would be set by regulation.
